BrochureContent.Content:
KEY FEATURES
•	Quiet position within the popular Charlesland development overlooking a large landscaped amenity green.
•	Converted attic providing valuable additional living space
•	Newly fitted, larger-than-standard contemporary kitchen
•	Quality quartz kitchen countertops
•	Remodeled designer bathroom with floor-to-ceiling tiling
•	Triple Glazed PVC Windows and Paladio Green PVC Front Door.
•	Updated Vokera Gas Boiler.
•	High-quality contemporary sanitary ware, fixtures and fittings
•	Extra large south-facing rear garden in with the added advantage of not being overlooked at the front.
•	Seomra-style garden room/home office
•	Excellent work-from-home options
•	Fitted for electric car charging
•	Close to neighbourhood shops, schools and everyday amenities
•	Within easy reach of Greystones town centre
•	Excellent transport links to Dublin

DESCRIPTION
Enjoying a quiet setting overlooking a large landscaped green within the ever-popular Charlesland development, this beautifully upgraded two-bedroom terraced home combines stylish contemporary living with a sunny south-facing garden and the added benefit of a converted attic and Seomra-style garden room.
Presented to a high standard throughout, the property has benefitted from a number of significant improvements, foremost of which include triple glazed windows, Paladio PVC Front Door, Upgraded main bathroom, gas  boiler replace, a newly fitted, larger-than-standard kitchen. Designed with both style and practicality in mind, the impressive kitchen space features contemporary fitted units complemented by quality quartz countertops and provides an inviting hub for day-to-day living and entertaining.
The property’s bathroom has also been comprehensively upgraded and finished to an excellent standard, with floor-to-ceiling tiling and a high-quality range of contemporary sanitary ware, fixtures and fittings.

Accommodation is further enhanced by the converted attic, providing valuable additional space.
Outside, one of the property’s standout features is its larger-than-normal south-facing back garden. Ideally positioned to make the most of the sun throughout the day, this private outdoor space offers plenty of room for relaxing, barbecues and entertaining family and friends.
The garden is further enhanced by a Seomra-style garden room/home office, providing a dedicated work-from-home space conveniently separated from the main house and equally suitable for use as a studio, gym or additional recreational space.

To the front, Number 200 enjoys a particularly appealing position in a quiet part of the development overlooking a large green area, combining a peaceful outlook with the convenience for which Charlesland is so well known.
With its upgraded kitchen and bathroom, converted attic, larger-than-average south-facing garden and separate home office/Seomra, Number 200 is an exceptionally appealing home in a highly convenient location.
Call us today to arrange a viewing of this must-see property.

LOCATION
Charlesland is a popular, exceptionally well-maintained residential development on the southern side of Greystones, with family-friendly features including landscaped amenity greens, mature trees and planting areas, walking routes and a children’s playground.
Number 200 enjoys a particularly attractive setting in a quiet part of the development overlooking a large green, while remaining within easy reach of the excellent range of everyday amenities available locally.
Charlesland has its own modern neighbourhood shopping centre, providing residents with convenient access to shops and services, while excellent roads, cycle paths and footpaths connect the development with the wider Greystones area.

Greystones town centre is approximately 2.5km away and offers an excellent selection of supermarkets, independent shops, boutiques and other retail outlets, together with the cafés, pubs, bistros and restaurants that help make the town such a popular lifestyle choice.
One of North Wicklow’s most sought-after coastal towns, Greystones combines an attractive seaside setting with excellent recreational amenities. These include the town’s beaches and seafront, Greystones Marina and Shoreline Leisure Centre, while the surrounding area offers easy access to the many walking trails and outdoor attractions for which County Wicklow is renowned.

Sports enthusiasts are particularly well catered for, with the wider Greystones area home to clubs and facilities catering for rugby, GAA, soccer, tennis, golf, sailing, rowing, cricket and a wide variety of other activities.

Families also benefit from an excellent choice of schools in Greystones, Charlesland and neighbouring Delgany, including primary and secondary options, together with a good selection of pre-school and Montessori facilities.

For commuters, Greystones DART station provides regular services to Dublin, while the area is also served by local and Dublin-bound bus routes. Easy access to the N11 puts the M50, Dublin and other major destinations within convenient driving distance.
Combining a coastal lifestyle with excellent amenities, schools, transport links and a thriving town centre, Greystones continues to be one of the most desirable places to live in North Wicklow.
